Funding rates are one of crypto's best-kept secrets.

→ Positive + extreme = too many longs → expect a flush
→ Negative + extreme = too many shorts → expect a squeeze
→ Near zero = balanced → follow the trend

Our screener checks funding across 200+ tokens every run.
It's free alpha hiding in plain sight.
